profile.headline: Software Engineer, iOS at Affirm, Inc.
profile.summary:
Some people are motivated by the "what" and the "how", and I'm motivated by the "why".

When I was little, I would take apart pens to inspect the individual pieces. Two things stood out to me: 1) either the ink cartridge or the "clicky button" rotates, 2) the spring is bouncy and fun. 

Naturally I would lose the springs, hidden somewhere in dull-colored carpet. From there, I learned two new things: 1) the spring is small but also a vital part of the pen, 2) everyone else's pens have springs I can "borrow" to fix my pen.

Likewise, this is how I approach writing and learning code. If I don’t investigate under the hood, I’ll never understand it. If you draw me a diagram of the React Flux cycle, it still won’t make sense until I play with the real code and “lose” things in there. And if I can’t fix my code, I will borrow your code.

positions.title: Whitebox QA Engineer
positions.description:
Set up testing frameworks and implemented tests for the iOS, Android, and web app. Wrote tests until my eyes bled. 

Frameworks I've worked with:
- Robot Framework
- XCTest, KIF
- JUnit, Robolectric, Mockito
- RSpec, Cucumber

positions.title: Booking and Marketing Coordinator
positions.description:
Developed a booking and sales system following clear SOPs used by several teams 
Solely handled incoming booking requests and delivered proposals for corporate bookings of 100+ guests
Digitally edited wireframes  and hundreds of photos during a full website remodeling

positions.title: English Teacher
positions.description: I adapted the American core curriculum to teach English to second-language learners. In order to make the American textbooks applicable to non-native speakers, I organized and lead creative extensions that explored the contrasts of American and Taiwanese cultures. Good communication with staff and students' parents were vital for a dynamic and successful learning environment.

positions.title: ESL Teacher
positions.description: I prepared daily classroom and coursework material, and taught a structured class set to combine language learning with fun and repetition. I constantly evaluated student's progress through written and oral exams, telephone practices, and individual tutoring. Constant communication with parents and students ensured the student's continued handwork and dedication to learning.

positions.title: Dorm Computer Consultant
positions.description: I provided technical assistance to students for hardware/software installations and troubleshooting. I solved technical problems for students and maintained computer lab equipment to ensure efficient operation.

volunteerExperiences.description: Starfish Foster Home, in Xi'an, China, was caring for 51 babies with special needs at the time of my stay. As a volunteer in a foreign environment with plenty of infants and toddlers, I was expected to do a wide-range of tasks including providing basic child care and physical therapy, photo-taking, and making hospital visits. I learned quite a lot about special needs, medical conditions, and developmental delays. It was also the most rewarding experience and I hope to return in the near future.

projects.title: Tetris
projects.description: A humble homage to the timeless classic; created to figure out what is going on "behind-the-scenes".

projects.title: Rails Lite
projects.description: A web server MVC framework inspired by the functionality of Ruby on Rails. All functionality is implemented with Ruby code.
